title.narrative: Police cooperation Colombia - development of new project

description.narrative:
The objective of this contribution is for the Swedish Police Agency (SPA) to identify areas for possible continued cooperation with the Colombian Police Agency (CNP), and to develop a project application to be submitted to the Embassy. The Embassy in Bogotá has supported cooperation between SPA and CNP since 2013, through 2 different project phases (phase 1 2013-2017 and phase 2 2018-2023). Identification of cooperation areas for a third phase will take place in close cooperation with the Colombian Police Agency.
Furthermore, so called bridging activities will be financed for activities that SPA carries out together with CNP on site in Colombia.

Målet med det här projektstödet är att Svenska Polismyndigheten (SPA) ska identifiera områden för eventuellt fortsatt samarbete med den colombianska polismyndigheten (CNP), och utveckla en projektansökan som ska lämnas in till Sida. Sida har gett stöd till samarbete mellan SPA och CNP sedan 2013, genom 2 olika projektfaser (fas 1 2013-2017 och fas 2 2018-2023). Vidare kommer s.k. "bryggaktiviteter" att finansieras för aktiviteteter som SPA genomför tillsammans med CNP på plats i Colombia.

The objective of this project support is for the Swedish Police Agency (SPA) to identify areas for possible continued cooperation with the Colombian National Police Agency (CNP), and to develop a project application to be submitted to Sida. Sida has provided support for collaboration between SPA and CNP since 2013, through 2 different project phases (phase 1 2013-2017 and phase 2 2018-2023). Furthermore, so-called ”bridging activities” will also be implemented, which SPA will carry out together with CNP on site in Colombia.

The key output of the preparatory phase was a project proposal. To develop the project proposal, this preparatory phase included:
- an LFA workshop (which resulted in an LFA report presenting the outcome of the discussions carried out, annexed to the Narrative report).
- a workshop to jointly specify the actual activities for the work plan
Furthermore, as part of the preparatory project a number of interim activities were carried out to ensure continuity in training and to maintain relationships among stakeholders. These activities contributed to preserve the progress achieved in crime prevention and police reform efforts.
During this project period, one activity within the component Leadership was carried out, one activity in Dialogue police training and finally support to and evaluation of the preventive approach of the police service that was included in the previous project.
The results achieved in this preparatory phase laid the groundwork for continued police reform and capacity-building efforts, which is a a priority in the new cooperation project.
No indicator available - only a description of the activity results is published
